path.description: Project root on this machine. `~` is expanded, relative paths are relative to the git root. null: the repo config's path is used, or the project is skipped without one.
path.title: Path

commit_prefix.description: Overrides the tracked and repo commit prefixes; null keeps them.
commit_prefix.title: Commit Prefix

no-add-to-repo-hint.description: Silences the hint to move this project's repository-internal local `path` into `sync_todos.repo.json`; true in any of the three config files counts.
no-add-to-repo-hint.title: No-Add-To-Repo-Hint

projects.description: Project name (as in the tracked mapping) to its machine-local settings.
projects.title: Projects
